## Publication Information

**Date:** 1868

**Genre:** Non-fiction: history

**Publisher:** London and New York: Macmillan and Company.

**Notes:** Macmillan’s Sunday Library (originally the Sunday Library for Household Reading) was published in monthly parts at 1<i>s.</i> each (of which the <i>Pupils</i> formed the first 3 parts) and quarterly volumes at 4<i>s.</i> each (of which it formed volume I).
